list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18 (Exophase / PSNProfiles). Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written in our own words from the official descriptions and the published guides cited beside it.

roadmap.text: Play the five chapters at your own pace and enjoy the story. Along the way, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude — the only trophy that may be missable), take optional missions as they appear, scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app, and study new animals through the binoculars. All of that counts toward the 100% checklist later, even though the checklist only becomes visible after the story. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter: missions cannot be replayed.
roadmap.title: Story first — and the one thing you must not skip

roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. PowerPyx calls the list lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but it is still the longest stretch: 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, and all 42 shooting range golds. Most miscellaneous trophies pop along the way. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off.
roadmap.title: The 100% checklist and the big grinds

roadmap.text: Strangers & Freaks is not part of 100%, so finish the 8 stranger strands last, along with the five named character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and Bret's hunting. Then check the list for anything still missing, clean it up, and the platinum follows.
roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and the final cleanup

trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. It unlocks automatically the moment the other 54 are yours, so there is no separate task — just work through the list. Expect the road to take around 200 hours, most of it the 100% cleanup after the story, and remember there are no online trophies and no DLC standing between you and it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it pops. You cannot miss it — just play the story. It is the first of 12 story trophies, all hidden, all automatic, and none of them can be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop a little late — PowerPyx notes the first three sometimes only trigger once you have cleared the first mission or two of the next chapter, so do not worry if it does not appear the instant the chapter ends. While you are still in Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation: it is the one thing in the game that may be missable (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Automatic and unmissable, like every story trophy. From Chapter 2 on, both characters can roam together, which opens the partner trophies (Hot Together and Retail Therapy) and the last meditation spots, which need both Jason and Lucia.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Automatic and unmissable. Chapter 3 is also when several tools and strands open up: the Snap Gun from a main mission (needed for Sneakthief), the dye pack jammer (for Dime on the Dollar), and the start of Andy's and Tyrone's stranger strands.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4, so from here on you can start working on Maximum Withdrawal's vaults — there are 8 in total and 100% completion needs all of them.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. This is the only gold among the story trophies, and it is the doorway to the real work: once the credits roll, free roam continues, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, and everything you need for the platinum is still reachable.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it unlocks by playing through the campaign — no side work is needed and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission trophy: play the campaign and it pops on its own. Heists like this one are also good practice for the bank-vault robberies that Maximum Withdrawal needs later.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Child's Play. Story mission trophy — automatic and unmissable. Just follow the campaign.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Headliners. Story mission trophy — automatic and unmissable. Just follow the campaign.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown. Story mission trophy — automatic and unmissable. The mission takes you to Vice City International Airport, the same place Catch Me If You Can needs a stolen passenger jet from, so you will already know the layout when you come back for that one.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission trophy — automatic and unmissable. Just follow the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which only becomes visible after the story — but anything you did during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls the list lenient: it is closer to 60% true completion. You need 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, plus every robbery, bank vault and gang operation. This is the hardest trophy and the longest grind, around 100 hours of the roughly 200-hour platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. PowerPyx counts 397 stunt opportunities across stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps; 100% completion wants 300 of them, so this trophy comes on the way. Work stunts in as you travel — jumping, flying low and driving fast all feed the counter.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything, so sample them as you come across them during the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the ranges as you pass them and chase the golds one weapon at a time; the ranges also feed the 100% checklist, so every gold helps twice. If a challenge resists you, come back with a better weapon or after practising the range's rhythm.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race; win them all and the trophy pops. Drone races are also on the 100% checklist, so a clean sweep here is progress twice over.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, and each race only counts once — so spread across the map instead of repeating your favourite. The race venues you find while exploring all feed this, and winning races also builds the driving practice the stunt and getaway trophies need.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1 — take the challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this counts toward two trophies at once.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Three video games run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines around Leonida — play one through to the end. Playing a video game is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. Lucia only — it starts with a phone call in Chapter 3. Work through Andy's missions as they come; like the other stranger strands, the quest giver can go quiet for stretches of the story but returns later, so it is not missable. All trophy-related quest givers are still there after the story in free roam.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand — 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later in the story, so do not worry if he vanishes for a while; the strand is not missable. Dive the wrecks as they are offered and the final mission closes the strand.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2. Ride through his missions as they appear; the strand is not missable and can be finished after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which ones — the five named character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus Bret's hunting are the core of it. This trophy is not part of 100% completion, so save it for the final cleanup step after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand — a wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3. Steal and deliver the cars he asks for; the strand is not missable and can be finished in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down labs in Vice City. Jason only, from Chapter 3. Clear the labs as they are offered; the strand is not missable and can be finished after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. THE ONE trophy that may be missable: in Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony. Follow her and accept the invitation. That meditation disappears after Chapter 1, and while it is unconfirmed whether it counts toward the 18, PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy unlocked — doing it costs a minute and removes the risk. The last meditation cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason only, from Chapter 2. PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it; clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks — which 100% completion needs anyway — should cover it. Study animals through the binoculars as you go: 100% wants 100 of 255 studied.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida; 100% completion needs 15 sets, so this trophy comes early in that hunt. Pick up every card you see while exploring and the sets fill in on their own.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK phone app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you pass them — scanning is enough, and it also feeds the vehicle and animal counts for 100% completion. Make a habit of scanning everything new: it costs seconds and pays off across three trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, available from the start and tracked in the progress menu; 100% needs 70, so this pops on the way. Just play widely — the challenges cover almost everything the game asks of you.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner along and escape the heat. Possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2. Bank jobs hand you 4 stars anyway, so this often pops during a heist — then just break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat dies.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. PowerPyx says it pops about 30 seconds after the third shop. Plan a short route of three shops, keep your partner with you, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them. Scan every new vehicle you see during the story and this finishes itself; 100% completion wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. PowerPyx reports that gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to. Find a gang fight, trigger Combat Focus with five gang members in range, and drop them all before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away from it. Expect the airport to fight back — get in, get the jet moving, and get clear of the runway before the response builds.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found tanks at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest of the map. Expect a heavy military response — grab it and go, and do not stop to fight what follows you.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you, so this only opens from Chapter 3 on. Plan the approach, stay out of sight lines, take what you came for, and leave clean — one spotted camera or witness and the attempt is done.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in total and 100% completion needs all of them, so plan on robbing every vault you find. Each vault is its own job — crack it, take the cash, and break away before the police box you in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts toward it, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier. Take the cash and break away before the police box you in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the corners; the game tracks 52 areas. Fly the borders, dip into every region, and watch the map fill in.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. 100% completion needs all 39 operations, so this pops early in that sweep — one operation per gang is enough for the trophy, but keep going: every operation counts toward the checklist.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact method is not yet confirmed by the guide writers — this is an early-days trophy, and the method will be pinned down as more players report it. Try the beachfront bars with a view and watch for the prompt; if nothing triggers, check back as the guides update.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is not yet confirmed — guide writers are still pinning it down. Expect it to involve a showroom, a fast car and the front window; try driving a stolen car straight out through the glass and see what pops.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later if you miss anything, so it is not missable — clear the operation, grab all three valuables, and get out.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The method guide writers report is to max out strength on both Jason and Lucia — work out together and both make progress. Treat the exact trigger as unconfirmed until more reports land; note that Push Square does not mark this one as hidden, so the lists disagree on it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Do 500 things that change your criminal profile — PSN tracks a count to 500. It comes naturally across a full playthrough; turn on criminal profile notifications in the UI settings to watch it climb, and do not worry about which choices you make.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Not yet confirmed — PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store. Try failing once and succeeding on the second attempt at a Payday Loans job, and check back as guides update. This is one of five trophies PowerPyx lists as not yet pinned down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Not yet confirmed — PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline. Keep an eye on strange lights and odd encounters in the open world; this one is still being mapped, so check back as players report what triggers it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Not yet confirmed — the in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. Try a melee strike from a moving bike at a pedestrian and see what pops.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills build up across robberies and add up over time; the dye pack jammer, which makes laundering smoother, unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission. Fences turn the bills into clean cash — keep robbing, keep laundering, and the total climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest. It counts across the whole playthrough, so it usually pops during the 100% cleanup — just buy what you need and the total takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. PowerPyx puts the total at $160,000. The real estate app arrives in Chapter 2 — buy garages as you can afford them. You also need garage space for the Scooter Bros registrations, so pair this with On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes — buy the garages, then register vehicles to the app as you collect them.
trophies.name: On the Spot
